OpsBot: Incident INC-20260315-42 created: elevated tail latency for Hosted API text-generation in eu-west. Monitoring and oncall engaged.
Sam (Product Ops): Heads up — seeing a tail latency spike for text-gen in eu-west since 02:14 UTC after a model rollout. ~12% of requests impacted, error rate still low. Root cause looks like cache thrash on a subset of nodes. ETA for mitigation ~40m. Need to coordinate customer-facing comms.
Priya (Marcom): Thanks. Can we put something on the status page now (investigating) and a short note to webinar registrants? We have a public webinar starting in ~45m. Two quick options for status page copy: 
Option A (short): "Investigating: elevated latency impacting text-generation in eu-west. Engineers are investigating and we will provide updates every 30 minutes."
Option B (customer-facing): "We’re investigating increased latency for text-generation requests originating in eu-west following a model rollout. Our engineers are mitigating the issue and performance is expected to improve as nodes recover. We’ll post updates here and notify customers with SLA contracts directly."
Which do people prefer? Also recommend we post as Investigating now and plan an update at +30m and +60m.
Diego (CS): We should definitely notify enterprise customers and any active trial users on eu-west who have open demos. For webinar: recommend we pause/hold (short delay) and send registrants a 25–30m delay email — less panic than cancel. Also route inbound at-risk leads to oncall/CS queue.
Sam (Product Ops): Agree on Investigating now. Ops team will push mitigation in ~15m; if that reduces tail latency we can update to Partial Recovery.
Marta (Legal): Quick note on wording: don’t commit to exact ETA in public copy. Don’t say "fixed in X minutes"; instead say "investigating, updates to follow". For enterprise emails we can be a bit more specific but avoid guarantees. Also include the support contact link and link to status page.
Priya (Marcom): Updated copy for status page (final): 
"Investigating — We are currently investigating elevated latency affecting text-generation requests in eu-west following a model rollout. Our engineering team is actively working to mitigate the issue. We will provide updates here and via customer email for impacted accounts. For urgent issues, contact support: https://redwood.example.com/support"
Draft email to webinar registrants (short): 
Subject: Quick update — webinar starting shortly
Body: "Hi — We’re currently investigating an intermittent performance issue affecting some Hosted API requests in eu-west. We’re pausing the webinar start by ~30 minutes while we confirm recovery. You can keep this link (webinar.example.com) and we’ll update you via email when we’re ready to begin. Thanks for your patience. — The Redwood Team"
Priya (Marcom): Routing plan: 1) Post status page now as Investigating. 2) Send targeted emails to enterprise accounts + webinar registrants. 3) Tweet a brief update (non-alarmist). 4) CS to tag impacted trial accounts in Intercom and route inbound leads to oncall. Need ok from Legal and CS on the email copy.
Diego (CS): OK — can do email send and Intercom tag. I’ll also set up a triage queue for inbound leads and flag the account managers for any active PoCs. Please include me in the email send so we can attach account context.
Marta (Legal): Approved the status page and webinar email copy with the caveat — remove ETA promise. Good to go from legal.
Sam (Product Ops): Ops plan executed: rollout revert queued in 10m, mitigations applied to cache policy. Will update thread at +15m with telemetry.
Priya (Marcom): Thanks all. I’ll coordinate the sends and translations (es, fr, de) if needed — UX copy team on standby. Holding webinar start and sending the short pause email now. Will post status update at +30m. :thumbsup:
Diego (CS): Got it — routing configured. Oncall will take inbound escalations (tagged: #incident-eu-west).
OpsBot: Update INC-20260315-42: mitigation deployed, tail latency trending down. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes.
Priya (Marcom): Draft of follow-up status update (to post if recovery holds): "Partial recovery — latency is decreasing for most customers in eu-west after mitigation. We continue to monitor and will update if any regressions occur. If you are still seeing issues, contact support with request id and example request times so we can prioritize."
Sam (Product Ops): Monitoring looks good so far. If metrics stay stable we’ll move to Resolved + root cause summary later today.
Marta (Legal): fine with partial recovery wording.
Priya (Marcom): Final: posted status page + sent webinar hold email and enterprise notices. Will follow up with translations and post the Resolved + RCA once Ops confirms. Thanks everyone.
Diego (CS): Thanks — will follow up with any customer replies and route to engineering if needed.
